test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains P and Q of lengths 320 m and 540 m, respectively, are running in the same direction on parallel tracks at 108 km/h and 144 km/h, respectively. How much time will the trains take to cross each other completely?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of 1st train (T₁) = 320 m

Length of 1st train (T₂) = 540 m

Speed of 1st train (S₁) = 108 km/h

Speed of 1st train (S₂) = 144 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ (T1 + T2) = (S2 - S1) × (5/18) × time

⇒ (320 + 540) = (144 - 108) × (5/18) × time

⇒ 860 = 36 × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = 860/10 = 86 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 86 sec.**
